claims: Artemis II launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
Artemis II launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center.
The crew of Artemis II consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back.
Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar flight since 1972.
The goal of Artemis II is a 10-day around-the-moon test flight validating Orion's life support systems with a crew.
The Artemis II crew is currently in high Earth orbit.
The Artemis II launch was successful.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to test the Orion capsule's systems on their way to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to solve minor initial issues with the onboard toilet on their way to the Moon.
